name: Kairos
description: Finds an input sequence that clears a level, checked by the game itself, and measures the frame window of every click. Based on gdsolver.

issues.info: Report problems on the GitHub issue tracker.

window-max-shift.name: Frame windows cap (ticks)
window-max-shift.description: How far each press and release is moved each way, in 240 Hz ticks (20 = 83 ms). A window that reaches it shows as 20+ (later) or 20- (earlier). Larger is slower.

windows-strict.name: Frame windows: strict mode
windows-strict.description: Replay every trial to the end of the level instead of stopping once the run is back on the macro's path. Much slower; the reported bounds are replayed to the end either way.

human-sigma-ms.name: Human timing spread (ms)
human-sigma-ms.description: How far off a human's clicks are, on average, for the success estimate in the frame windows stats.

rhythm-speed.name: Rhythm practice scroll speed (px/s)
rhythm-speed.description: How fast the notes of the rhythm practice move to the hit line.

time-limit-minutes.name: Exact path time limit (minutes)
time-limit-minutes.description: The exact search (K button) stops after this long and saves its best attempt. 0 = no limit.

solver-threads.name: Solver threads
solver-threads.description: CPU threads the solver's search uses. 0 = half of this computer's (2 to 16). More is faster; the plan found is the same.

auto-optimize.name: Optimize after Solve
auto-optimize.description: When a Solve finds a solution, optimize it right away (fewer clicks, human timings). Off: you are asked.

go-crazy.name: Go crazy!
go-crazy.description: No human limits on the solution's inputs: presses and releases as short as one tick, any click rate. Off: every press and release lasts at least the human minimum below.

human-min-pulse.name: Human minimum press/release (ticks)
human-min-pulse.description: Shortest press and shortest gap between two presses in a solution, in 240 Hz ticks (6 = 25 ms). Ignored with Go crazy!

max-cps.name: Max clicks per second
max-cps.description: Solve and Optimize keep two presses at least 1/N second apart. 0 = no limit (the minimum press and gap above already cap it at 240 / (2 x that) per second). Ignored with Go crazy!

play-menu.name: Choose the mode on Play
play-menu.description: A level's play button opens a menu: Normal, Replay or Solve. Off, the play button just plays the level, as without the mod.

solve-gamble.name: Solve faster (not reproducible)
solve-gamble.description: The search takes a shortcut as soon as it will do instead of waiting for its full ladder. Usually faster, but the same level can take a different route and time from one solve to the next, and it is no more certain to be solved. Every plan is still checked by the game itself. Takes effect at the next Solve.

key-overlay.name: Hide the overlay
key-overlay.description: Refused while solving, and it never hides the bot badge.

key-render.name: Rendering on / off
key-render.description: Only during a solve, where the frames go back to the fast loop. A replay you cannot see is not a replay.

key-seek-back.name: Seek back
key-seek-back.description: A frame step instead while the game is stopped. Refused during a solve.

key-seek-forward.name: Seek forward
key-seek-forward.description: A frame step instead while the game is stopped. Refused during a solve.

key-takeover-end.name: End the human takeover
key-takeover-end.description: Debugging: ends a takeover session started with cfg takeover= and closes its records.
